subject: SupplyPlus onboarding — persistent login loop after SSO cert rotation
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@supplyplus.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SupplyPlus onboarding invite keeps redirecting / login loop

Hi Kimberly,

We received the invite to Redwood's supplier portal (Zip), but every time one of our team clicks the link it bounces between the SSO page and an 'Activation Required' landing page — they never get to the form. We tried in Chrome and Safari, cleared cookies, and used incognito. Attached is a quick screenshot and the trace ID shown in the browser console.

Can you confirm the invite link and whether you rotated any SSO certs or changed load balancer settings? This is blocking our AP team from completing banking info; PO processing is paused.

Thanks,
Alex Ramos
Head of Vendor Ops — SupplyPlus, Inc.
Onboarding: onboarding@supplyplus.com

Attachment(s): screenshot-redirect-logs.png, session-trace-1623.txt

From: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: alex.ramos@supplyplus.com
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SupplyPlus onboarding invite keeps redirecting / login loop

Ben/Marissa — FYI, SupplyPlus is stuck on onboarding. They included the trace ID and a screenshot. Initial troubleshooting notes: we rotated the IdP cert late last night as part of a scheduled maintenance (non-customer-facing), and nginx-ingress was restarted in dedicated cluster-3. I suspect session affinity cookie name changed after restart which can cause sticky-session mismatches between the auth gateway and app nodes.

Can infra toggle session-affinity back to the previous cookie or add a compatibility rule? If that's too risky, can we push a one-time reissue of the invite link that forces a fresh session handshake? SupplyPlus needs to complete the W-9 and banking fields before PO is issued.

Alex — sharing small trace and attaching logs to this thread; we have the HubSpot deal linked below. I will coordinate a temporary workaround and confirm once infra responds.

—Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0198

Attachment(s): session-trace-1623.txt
Related: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-4827

From: ben_carter@redwood.example.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, infra-oncall@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SupplyPlus onboarding invite keeps redirecting / login loop

Kim — thanks for the heads up. I'm seeing the ingress config change in the deploy logs around 02:10 UTC (cert rotation ticket CERT-918). The quick mitigation I'm going to try: re-enable legacy cookie acceptance on the auth gateway and set the lb cookie 'SRW-STICK' to accept both the old and new names for 30m. That should re-establish affinity for in-flight invites without rolling back certs.

If that doesn't work within 20 minutes, we'll issue a new invite token scoped to a single-use session and whitelist the SupplyPlus IP range for the handshake window. Marissa, can you confirm SupplyPlus's AP contact for the IP whitelist?

- Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@supplyplus.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SupplyPlus onboarding invite keeps redirecting / login loop

Alex — quick update: Ben applied the compatibility rule and I confirmed with my test invite that the redirection loop is resolved. Can you please ask your team to clear cookies once and retry the original invite link? If anyone still gets the landing page, reply with the browser console trace (the one you already attached is perfect) and we will issue a fresh single-use invite token and whitelist your IPs during the handshake window.

Next steps for PO flow: once onboarding is complete, we'll confirm vendor taxonomy and create the first PO draft under DEAL-4827. Marissa will follow up with a short checklist to ensure your banking details map to our payment terms.

Apologies for the interruption — we had an IdP cert rotation that changed cookie behavior; Ben applied a short-lived compatibility fix.

Best,
